turns.replyText:
My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
I’m sorry your item arrived damaged.
According to Naked Wardrobe’s policy, if your item is DEFECTIVE, DAMAGED, OR INCORRECT, you should INITIATE AN EXCHANGE REQUEST THROUGH THE RETURN PORTAL and select the appropriate reason. You’ll be asked to provide:
- a brief description of the issue
- an image of the item
- an image of the CARE TAG located on the inside of the garment
Their team will review the request, and IF APPROVED, YOU’LL RECEIVE AN EMAIL WITH A PREPAID LABEL.
The policy also states that ONLY ITEMS RECEIVED DAMAGED OR INCORRECT ARE ELIGIBLE FOR AN EXCHANGE, and they can ONLY EXCHANGE THE SAME STYLE.
If you want, I can also help you find the return portal link.
